description.zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
description.en: The ID of the application. The ID is generated when you create the application in the console. It contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length.
The unique ID of the live room.

description.zh: 操作人ID，仅支持英文和数字，最大长度36位。
description.en: The ID of the operator. Only letters and digits are supported. Maximum length: 36 characters.
